# Where each mob's ATTACK_DAMAGE base value is set, javap -c -p -constants excerpts from the pinned
# pack zip. Vanilla classes come from minecraft_server.1.12.2.jar (the zip's root, SHA-256
# fe1f9274e6dad9191bf6e6e8e36ee6ebc737f373603df0946aafcded0d53167e), which is obfuscated: adh is
# SharedMonsterAttributes (its static init names "generic.attackDamage" as field f with default 2.0),
# wd.a(D)V is setBaseValue, wg.b registerAttribute, vi is EntityList (register(id, name, class,
# oldName) gives each obf class its registry name), ade is EntityMob (zombie's superclass, registers
# adh.f), bM is applyEntityAttributes. Mod classes use SRG names (field_111264_e ATTACK_DAMAGE,
# func_111128_a setBaseValue, func_110147_ax applyEntityAttributes).

     156: putstatic     #259                // Field f:Lwc;

     162: dup
